title: Eternalhardcore
description: a minecraft serer that if you die you get banned for 30m
body:
EternalHardcore is a brutal hardcore survival Minecraft server where every life matters.
IP: play.eternalhardcore.xyz

Unlike normal survival servers, dying on EternalHardcore results in a 30 minute ban, making PvP, exploration, and every decision intense and meaningful. Fight to survive, build alliances, raid enemies, and become one of the few players strong enough to stay alive.

Features
☠️ 30 Minute Death Ban System
⚔️ Competitive Hardcore Survival
🏰 Raiding & PvP
💎 Custom Features & Plugins
🔥 Active Community
🚀 Frequent Updates & Events
🛡️ Optimized Performance

Every battle has consequences. Every victory matters.

Do you have what it takes to survive?

Join now: play.eternalhardcore.xyz
